description: This file defines the StringDatabaseStorage class for storing and managing localized strings in a Drupal database, including methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting strings and translations.

classes.name: StringDatabaseStorage
classes.description: A class implementing StringStorageInterface to handle storage of localized strings in a Drupal database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the storage with a database connection and optional connection options.

methods.name: getStrings
methods.description: Retrieves strings based on conditions, returning SourceString objects.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Retrieves translation strings based on conditions, returning TranslationString objects.

methods.name: findString
methods.description: Finds a specific source string matching conditions.

methods.name: findTranslation
methods.description: Finds a specific translation string matching conditions.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Fetches location data for strings based on conditions.

methods.name: countStrings
methods.description: Counts total source strings.

methods.name: countTranslations
methods.description: Counts total translations grouped by language.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a string object, inserting or updating as needed, and updates locations.

methods.name: updateLocation
methods.description: Updates location data for a string.

methods.name: checkVersion
methods.description: Ensures string version matches Drupal version, updating if necessary.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a string and associated data.

methods.name: deleteStrings
methods.description: Deletes multiple strings based on conditions.

methods.name: deleteTranslations
methods.description: Deletes translations based on conditions.

methods.name: createString
methods.description: Creates a new SourceString object.

methods.name: createTranslation
methods.description: Creates a new TranslationString object.

methods.name: dbFieldTable
methods.description: Returns table alias based on field name.

methods.name: dbStringTable
methods.description: Returns the database table name for a string object.

methods.name: dbStringKeys
methods.description: Retrieves key fields for a string object.

methods.name: dbStringLoad
methods.description: Loads multiple string objects based on conditions.

methods.name: dbStringSelect
methods.description: Builds a complex SELECT query for strings with conditions and options.

methods.name: dbStringInsert
methods.description: Inserts a new string record into the database.

methods.name: dbStringUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing string record in the database.

methods.name: dbDelete
methods.description: Creates a delete query for a specified table and keys.

methods.name: dbExecute
methods.description: Executes an arbitrary SELECT query with options.
